verdict.rationale: PayPal documents and runtime-probes an official MCP server (developer.paypal.com/ai-tools/mcp-server) plus a published agent-toolkit npm/PyPI package explicitly listing MCP as a supported integration, and a live probe confirms the remote MCP endpoint (mcp.paypal.com/mcp) responds with proper OAuth-protected-resource metadata. missing for 10: independent/community hands-on confirmation of a successful end-to-end MCP client connection (beyond PayPal's own docs and the auth-handshake probe), and clearer documentation of the full tool list exposed over MCP.
